title: Promote explicit network lifecycle and block standalone launch in network modes
summary: Implement the first durable coordinator/worker operating-mode boundary: network roles block normal Launch, lifecycle routes become backend-owned command surfaces, and Network UI exposes role-aware lifecycle controls.
reason: Coordinator and worker settings must not behave like standalone processing. Operators need explicit Network/Workers controls and backend guardrails before distributed execution can be trusted.
behavior_before: NetworkRole settings could coexist with normal Launch behavior, and Network lifecycle contracts were design-only with no backend command surface.
behavior_after: Standalone pipeline Launch is blocked in network roles, Launch preflight explains the network-mode boundary, lifecycle command routes provide backend-owned dry-run/confirmed command results, and the Network UI can render role-aware lifecycle controls.
manual_validation: py_compile targeted backend network/launch/API modules - passed
unittest focused network lifecycle/local-api/webview/tauri suite: 106 tests - passed
unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_settings_launch_smoke - failed: repeated Library Route Map graph/decision matrix timeout after Network auth-secret assertion; no media mutation evidence
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed only on unrelated dependency-atlas assets: dependency_detail_core_library png/svg and dependency_detail_desktop_watch png/svg
rollback_plan: Revert the network lifecycle facade/API/WebView changes and focused tests in this packet, then rerun the process launch, Local API contract, and Network WebView tests.
notes:
This packet intentionally implements the enforceable lifecycle boundary first. Full media-processing worker execution is guarded behind backend lifecycle/provider readiness and follow-up validation.
Change packet opened for coordinator/worker lifecycle implementation.
